HalfElf_Commoner
Brialavant is one of the customers waiting in line at the Counting House in the Lower City.
“
If you cannot get the coin you need here, try for a room at the Elfsong. Alan has plenty of space in his upper floors.
„
— Brialavant

Involvement

Brialavant stands in line waiting his turn to get serviced by  Clerk Chervis, an employee of the Counting House who seems to be very busy. Brialavant himself is mostly busy complaining about the gnomish lady  Gilla Merrun standing before him in line.

Idle banter

  • Brialavant
    I see - she's too important to wait in line! Figures.
  • Brialavant
    I wonder when she'll demand to speak to the manager.
  • Brialavant
    By the roots! This gnome lady ahead of me is like to blow her top.
